description: HBB (beta-globin) vertical slice: gene, MANE Select transcript, sequences, UniProt P68871, the HbS variant, PDB 2HBS and its residue mapping.
notes: First gene (Phases 1 to 8). 2HBS is the deoxy sickle haemoglobin entry in which the variant residue (HbS, beta 6 Val in mature numbering, UniProt position 7) is observed; the HBB_CONFIG constant in packages/scientific-core/src/slice/types.ts mirrors this file and a test keeps them equal.
